name: Specular Button
description: Glassy button with a WebGL specular highlight that travels around its rounded rim, follows the nearby cursor, flares on press, and can orbit on its own.
contents: Native button element with a translucent tinted glass background
WebGL2 canvas overlay drawing the rim highlight and hairline border
Children slot for the label or icon content
behavior: Highlight steers toward the pointer along the button outline as the cursor gets within the proximity distance, and brightens with closeness
At rest the highlight settles at the top-left corner at idle intensity
autoAnimate makes the highlight orbit continuously at speed radians per second, unless the user prefers reduced motion
Pressing the button briefly widens and brightens the highlight
Rendering pauses when the button is off screen and when nothing is animating
Scales down on active press, dims at 50 percent opacity when disabled
editableByProps: Label or content, size preset (sm, md, lg), corner radius
Glass tint color and opacity, backdrop blur, text color
Highlight color, rim base color, intensity, idle intensity, size, fade, thickness and glow
Cursor following on or off, proximity distance, auto orbit and orbit speed
Disabled state, click handler, button type, className, inline style and any extra button attributes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the drop shadow, press scale or focus ring
Change highlight shape, falloff or glow pool
Change follow smoothing or press decay speed
needsCodeEdit.where: frame function inside the first useEffect

fixed: Requires WebGL2; without it the button renders as a plain tinted button with no highlight
Draws the highlight on a canvas extending 24px beyond the button on every side (PAD), so parent overflow hidden will clip it
Listens to pointer events on window and the document element while mounted, and removes them on unmount
Default colors are light on dark, so it needs a dark or colorful background to be visible
Cursor following depends on a hovering pointer, on touch it only reacts to press
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by disabling the auto orbit
Works at small screens since size is set by padding and content, but long labels do not wrap
